LanguageData.RL_SettingsNewFloors: Limits new floors only; existing floors and access are preserved.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsHiddenPanelHelp: Hiding the panel keeps floor hotkeys active. Mountain migration is also available on the Recovery page.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsSpaceExpansion: Allow new floors on space maps
LanguageData.RL_SettingsQuotaHelp: Empty floors count. Only removing a map releases its used quota. The quota protects resources; it is not a frame-rate guarantee. Space excavation remains unavailable.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsSaveCompatibility: Saves containing floors beyond the old ±2 limits cannot be loaded with an older RimLayers DLL.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsCurrentDefinitions: Existing blueprints and demolition returns use the current definitions. Indirect-fire range is unchanged.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsUndergroundHelp: Existing underground terrain is never regenerated. Initial hives also obey difficulty and scenario rules.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsAutoRecovery: Automatically recover entities in invalid airspace
LanguageData.RL_SettingsRecoveryHelp: Compatibility recovery adds no damage. If no legal position exists, the original entity waits in persistent storage. Disabling automatic recovery keeps existing queued entities.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsExclusions: Recovery exclusions (Def names, separated by commas)
LanguageData.RL_SettingsExclusionsHelp: Exclusions affect recovery only, not terrain, pathing or structural rules.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsResetConfirm: Restore all RimLayers settings? Existing floors and recovery contents will be kept.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsLoadGameForUsage: Load a game to see floor usage.
LanguageData.RL_SettingsShipHeight: A gravship payload can span at most six above-ground decks.
LanguageData.RL_QuotaUpperLimit: The upper-floor limit prevents adding this floor.
LanguageData.RL_QuotaUndergroundLimit: The underground-floor limit prevents adding this floor.
LanguageData.RL_QuotaSpace: New floors are disabled on space maps; underground excavation is never allowed there.
LanguageData.RL_QuotaGlobalLimit: The save-wide extra-floor quota is full, including transport reservations.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryCounts: {0} pending; {1} in suspended storage. Automatic retries use the original map only.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryEmpty: No entities are waiting for recovery.
LanguageData.RL_RecoverySelectHelp: Select an entity to specify a legal landing. Stored entities keep their original identity and contents; their own simulation is suspended.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryChooseLanding: Specify a landing for the selected entity
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryLandingHelp: X/Z are logical floor coordinates. No floors are created and no other entity is displaced. A removed source map requires explicit confirmation before recovery elsewhere.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryCrossMapQuestion: The original map is gone. Move {0} to {1}?
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryCrossMapConfirm: Cross-map recovery requires a removed source map and explicit confirmation.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryIllegalLanding: That cell is not a legal, supported and safe landing for this entity.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryNotStored: The entity is no longer in recovery storage.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryCannotLocate: The source map or its original coordinates are no longer available.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryWarning: RimLayers detected {0} recovery issues. Open Mod settings → RimLayers → Recovery → Pending recovery. Unknown buildings are not moved.
LanguageData.RL_RecoveryReasonRepeatedMovement: Repeated external movement; automatic correction paused
